note: THE EVENT's fixed ids and sizes (docs/vip.md; docs/daily-suitcase.md), read by src/net/suitcase.ts, functions/checker/build.rs and tools/server/make-config.mts. The events (two weeks each, about 7 items, each twice), their tables and each day's item are Levels' (src/content/levels/events.json). Every other id is name-based (make-config's uuid5): an item 'suitcase:item:<item id>', an event's prize mark 'suitcase:prize:<event id>', an event's table 'table:<slug>' (src/net/tables.json). An id never changes once uploaded. `event` is the old monthly Arcade challenge, declared and written by nothing now (the Arcade cannot show a challenge to VIPs alone); `prize` is the helpers a full suitcase pays with its table, clamped at the cap; `spares` is what one swap takes; `stack` is the most copies of one item kept; `shelf` the most past events the game is told about; `builtInTable` is every player's own table, which is no item, so an event showing it (a stand-in) pays only the helpers. `on` is THE EVENT'S SWITCH, and on means ON FOR VIPS (the creator, 2026-10-30: the event returns two weeks long for Gem Arcade VIP members only): for anyone else, and for everyone while it is false, no player sees the event (src/ui), the checker packs no item, swaps nothing and pays no prize. Who is VIP is the checker's word (functions/checker/src/vip.rs): nobody on test and release until the platform can say. A function cannot read the game config, so the switch is this file, compiled into the checker. functions/checker/tests/suitcase.rs holds the shipped value.
